The Studio

Not a salon visit — a standing appointment with yourself.

Nina Nails built its name in Corona on one belief: great nails are never rushed. Every appointment starts with a real consultation and ends with you knowing exactly how to keep the look alive at home.

  • Experienced nail techs only — no hand-offs, no surprises
  • Honest timelines & honest pricing, up front
  • Premium products, gentle on natural nails

— Good to know

Before you book.

Every service lists its duration and price up front — and if it's not right, we make it right. That's our guarantee.

How much will it cost?

Services run from $5 (Nail fix) to $60 (Full Set Acrylics) — prices as listed on the salon's booking page. The final price is confirmed at your consultation, before any work begins. Nail art and extensions are quoted after we see your nails, so the price you approve is the price you pay.

How long will my appointment take?

A manicure takes 45–60 minutes; a full set takes around 90 minutes. Every service lists its duration, and your nail tech confirms it at booking — no rushing, no surprises.

What if I don't like the result?

If it's not right, we make it right — re-do, fix or adjust, no charge. That's our guarantee.

What to expect at your first visit

A real consultation first: your nail tech looks at your nails, asks how you wear them, and agrees the shape and design with you before starting. You leave knowing exactly how to keep the look alive at home.

10% off your first visit

New clients save 10% on their first appointment — mention this page when you book.

“After having a bad experience at a different nail salon, I came to Nina Nails to have my nails redone. Even though they were very busy, they welcomed me as a walk in. Their kindness, professionalism, and willingness to make things right turned my experience around completely. I truly appreciate them, and I will definitely be returning. If you're looking for a nail salon that stands behind their work and genuinely cares about their customers, I highly recommend Nina Nails on Main Street in Corona!”
